display_name: Alpine H200 (example: fill in and verify)
notes: Partition, QoS and GPU names come from the September 2026 CellQuant pipeline profiles and have not been re-checked. Check them against the current CURC Alpine documentation before use.
A 71 GB H200 MIG slice held typical 1024 x 1024 nuclear 3D Cellpose work with room to spare in earlier runs (about 3-4 GB used); a full H200 is gpu:h200:1.
Set runtime_contract_path to the runtime.json the maintainer exported for the cluster environment, and runtime_sha256 to its SHA-256.
